companies.description: ABB is a technology leader in electrification and automation, offering a wide range of products and services to enable a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. Their typical customers are industrial and manufacturing companies, as well as businesses in the energy sector. ABB differentiates themselves by connecting engineering know-how and software to optimize how things are manufactured, moved, powered, and operated, driving innovations that accelerate industrial transformation.
companies.name: ABB Asea Brown Boveri Ltd.

companies.description: Schaeffler AG is a global automotive and industrial supplier that offers a wide range of products, including bearings, linear technology, and automotive engine components. Their typical customers include original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in the automotive, aerospace, and industrial sectors. Schaeffler positions itself as a technology-driven company that focuses on innovation and sustainability to provide high-quality and reliable products to its customers.
companies.name: Schaeffler AG

companies.description: SKF Group designs and manufactures rolling-element bearings, seals, lubrication systems and bearing housings and supplies related services such as condition monitoring, aftermarket parts and engineering support. They primarily sell to OEMs and industrial end-users across multiple sectors and claim to differentiate through an integrated offering of components, monitoring systems and services aimed at improving rotating-equipment performance.
companies.name: SKF Group

companies.description: Kohler Company is a manufacturing company that offers a wide range of products and services, including plumbing fixtures, furniture, cabinetry, tile, engines, and generators. Their typical customers are homeowners, designers, architects, and contractors who are seeking high-quality, innovative, and sustainable products for their building and remodeling projects. Kohler differentiates themselves by positioning themselves as a brand that celebrates bold ideas and innovative design solutions, while also prioritizing sustainability and customer satisfaction.
companies.name: Kohler Ventures

companies.description: Air Products supplies industrial and specialty gases and related equipment and services to industrial and commercial customers, focusing on bulk and on-site gas supply, gas production plants and equipment, and engineering/project delivery; they emphasize large-scale supply capabilities, engineered project execution, and hydrogen-related solutions.
companies.name: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc.
Benko Products, Inc.
companies.description: Benko Products manufactures and sells industrial material-handling equipment—primarily industrial ovens/drum heaters, industrial refrigerators, safety gates, access/fall-protection platforms, loading/unloading systems, and chemical storage buildings—for business customers in manufacturing and industrial operations. They emphasize their long product development history and branded product lines (Sahara Hot Box, GREEN Access & Fall Protection, Protect-O-Gate, Husky Cold Box, EPI Chemical Storage) as differentiators.

companies.name: York Repair Inc.
companies.description: York Repair Inc. provides electric motor repair and electromechanical field services for industrial customers, focusing on large AC/DC motors and servo motors. They emphasize capabilities such as high-capacity VPI impregnation, full rewinds, on-site testing and alignment, and a stocked inventory of servo motors and parts to reduce downtime.

companies.name: Precision Coil & Rotor
companies.description: Precision Coil & Rotor manufactures and rebuilds coils and rotor components for AC and DC motors and generators up to 13.8 kV. They serve industrial B2B customers such as OEMs, power generation and industrial facilities, and offer coil manufacturing, VPI and hot-press processing, rotor rewind/repair, stator core testing/rebuilding, and field service. They emphasize ISO-9001-2015 certification, experienced engineering and field staff, technology investment, and the ability to handle rush and emergency schedules.

companies.name: Kurz Industrial Solutions
companies.description: Kurz Industrial Solutions provides electric motor and rotating-equipment repair, parts distribution, and automation equipment sales to industrial and clean-energy customers, and they claim specialized capabilities in precision spindle/servomotor rebuilding, renewable energy maintenance, local engineering support, and rapid turnaround.

companies.name: Red Stick Armature Works, Inc.
companies.description: Red Stick Armature Works provides certified repair and precision rewinding for AC/DC motors, generators, and transformers, and sells authorized new motors and VFDs while offering field engineering, installation, inventory management, and climate‑controlled storage. They serve industrial customers such as petrochemical, power generation, manufacturing, pulp & paper, marine/offshore, and water/wastewater operations, and position themselves as a single provider combining repair services with authorized motor distribution and 24/7 intake.

companies.name: H & N Electric, Power Systems by Timken
The Association of Electrical and Mechanical Trades (AEMT)
companies.description: The Association of Electrical and Mechanical Trades (AEMT) provides services and support to companies in the electrical and mechanical service and repair industry. Their typical customers are companies involved in the repair, maintenance, and reconditioning of electrical and mechanical equipment. AEMT claims to differentiate themselves by promoting engineering excellence, supporting sustainable thinking and quality craftsmanship, and fostering leadership in the industry. They position themselves as the beating heart of the industry, helping their members keep the world rotating and underpin a circular economy by reducing industrial product and energy waste.

companies.name: A&C Electric Company
companies.description: A&C Electric Company provides repair, testing, refurbishment, and sales of industrial and servo electric motors and related motion components for industrial customers. They serve manufacturing and maintenance operations with send-in repairs, exchange/reconditioned motor sales, OEM parts replacements, diagnostic lab services, and motor management programs, and they claim extensive OEM-part usage, inventory depth, warranties, and rapid turnaround options.

companies.name: Ace Viking Electric Motor Co
companies.description: Ace Viking Electric Motor Co provides sales, repair, and on-site service for industrial electrical and mechanical equipment—primarily electric motors, pumps, compressors, gearboxes, and VFDs—serving industrial and municipal customers. They position themselves as a long-running industrial solutions provider offering emergency repairs, retrofitting, and plant services to support operations.

companies.name: Samatic
companies.description: SAMATIC manufactures and sells automatic random coil winding machines and related tooling for electric motor and generator winding, serving motor repair shops and rewind businesses. They position their SAMATIC line on claims of precision, consistent tension control, ease of insertion, unique concentric formers, automated features (learning mode, automatic sleeve release) and direct sales only.

companies.name: Gateway Engineering, Inc.
companies.description: Gateway Engineering, Inc. provides client-focused civil engineering and land surveying services. Their typical customers are likely to include land developers, real estate companies, government agencies, and construction firms. They claim to differentiate themselves by offering personalized and tailored solutions to meet their clients' specific needs, providing a high level of expertise and customer service, and delivering projects on time and within budget.

companies.name: Ganz Transformers and Electric Rotating Machines Ltd.
Quality Bearings Belts and Roller Chain

companies.description: Stockdales Electric Motor Corporation distributes electric motors, variable speed drives, and gearing while providing motor repair/rewind and industrial controls engineering. They serve industrial and commercial customers and claim to differentiate by combining distribution with control-system design, drive solutions, and onsite repair services.
companies.name: Stockdales Electric Motor Corporation

companies.description: West Coast Rewind provides motor rewind, overhaul and severe-duty motor manufacturing services for industrial customers, emphasizing in-house electrical production, advanced insulation and spike-resistant components, extensive testing capabilities, faster turnaround and a 12-month workmanship warranty.
companies.name: West Coast Rewind

companies.description: Armature Electric supplies and repairs electric motors and related control equipment for industrial and commercial customers. They combine a large stocked inventory of low- and medium/high-voltage motors, drives and accessories with a full-service workshop and 24/7 field service offering, and they emphasize long-term vendor relationships and extensive in-house repair capacity.
companies.name: Armature Electric Ltd.

companies.description: Eura Drives Flagship Products is a company that specializes in offering a range of electric drive products and automation solutions. Their flagship products include frequency converters, servo systems, soft starters, PLCs, and HMIs. They cater to a diverse customer base, including industries such as automotive, industrial machinery, packaging, printing, and new energy. Eura Drives positions itself as a provider of high-efficiency, safe, and reliable products that cater to the needs of various electric vehicles and industrial applications, with a focus on creating exceptional value for their customers through outstanding performance and powerful functionality.
companies.name: Eura Drives Flagship Products

companies.description: Milbank Industrial Electric provides repair, rewinding and refurbishment services for electromechanical rotating equipment (AC/DC motors, generators, pumps). They serve industrial and utility customers and claim specialist capabilities including large-machine rewinds, on-site repairs, hazardous-atmosphere accreditation, and 24/7 response.
companies.name: Milbank Industrial Electric
